formattedAddress: No. 1之8號, Zhongshan Rd, Zhongxin Village, Beitou District, Taipei City, Taiwan 112

text.text:
Should have read the latest reviews, before coming here. Avoid this place, unfortunately it leaves a bad impression. After ordering Ramen,
I went to wash my hands and lady was asking me, while I was in a bathroom, if I want tofu and egg. I said, yes since  I thought this will  be part of Ramen. When paying, I realized that these were all extras. So instead of 399, the lady wanted to charge me 699. I protested, since I found it unfair. The lady, who previously was speaking English, "forgot" all her english and even started to talk loudly, telling me that "how can you think that there can be a tofu in ramen".
Avoid this place and remember, that whatever the lady offers will require an extra charge.

text.text: The name of the restaurant in Chinese means satisfaction. But in reality, the dining experience made us dissatisfaction. The ramen was amazingly small, just half of the bowl with very little soup. The chicken, the pork, the fried tofu and the fried oyster were just average. The only tasty one was the scallop. The food was pricey. You could get much better and inexpensive food elsewhere.

text.text: The noodle restaurant is not posh but felt very cosy. The service was poor. The order was rushed, and the waitress was a bit impatient. I didn't consider the food was value for money. The price was at the high end, but they didn't take credit cards or issue proper receipts.

text.text:
Went to try out this Ramen restaurant in Beitou, which is really nice.
We tried the ramen, curry rice, and fried toufu, all are nice.
The soup is not salty, and the pork cutlets are soft and tender. As for the toufu, crispy outside soft inside.
Dessert, we have the fried and round mochi. All are nice too.
Good place for wheelchair elderly as the shop is at L1.
Only issue is toilet locate at L2.
